Para maior comodidade, a fração dispõe ainda de garagem e duas arrecadações, garantindo espaço extra para arrumação e uma experiência de habitação mais prática e funcional. Uma oportunidade para viver numa das zonas mais procuradas da linha, entre o mar, os acessos e a qualidade de vida que Paço de Arcos oferece. Located in the prestigious Condomínio da Giribita, in Paço de Arcos, this T3+1 apartment offers a rare combination of residential tranquillity, proximity to the sea, and excellent accessibility. With generous living areas and a well-balanced layout, the property benefits from abundant natural light and a comfortable separation between the social and private areas of the home. One of its standout features is the spacious sea-view terrace, accessible from both the living room and the master suite the perfect setting to enjoy sunny breakfasts, peaceful evenings, or simply take in the stunning ocean views. For added convenience, the property also includes a garage and two storage rooms, providing extra practicality and organisation. An excellent opportunity to live in one of the most sought-after areas along the Lisbon coastline, where quality of life, the sea, and easy access come together in perfect harmony. Situé dans la prestigieuse Condomínio da Giribita, à Paço de Arcos, cet appartement T3+1 offre une combinaison rare entre tranquillité résidentielle, proximité de la mer et accès facilité aux principaux axes.
